meta.purpose: Pinned address roots for the protocol matrix. These are the ONLY addresses in the fixture pipeline that do not come from an on-chain read. Every other address is derived from these at the pinned block (see derived_on_chain). Sourced mechanically from an immutable upstream artifact and re-verifiable with: node scripts/protocol-reads.mjs --verify-roots

upstream.note: Same address-book commit already cited by matrix section 2 for the Pool implementation mapping. The commit pin makes the source immutable; the sha256 makes the pin self-verifying, so a silently retargeted commit or a mutated raw endpoint fails closed rather than substituting a different address.

ADDRESSES_PROVIDER.role: The single Aave root. Pool, AaveProtocolDataProvider, AaveOracle and ACLManager are all read from it, and the Pool round-trips ADDRESSES_PROVIDER() back to this value.

WETH.role: Flagship borrow asset. Independently confirmed on-chain: present in Pool.getReservesList() and symbol() == WETH.

weETH.role: Flagship collateral asset, and the EtherFi root: eETH and the EtherFi LiquidityPool are read from it. Independently confirmed on-chain: present in Pool.getReservesList() and symbol() == weETH.

wstETH.role: Lido root (reference only; Lido execution is out of P1 scope per SPEC section 8). stETH is read from it. Independently confirmed on-chain: present in Pool.getReservesList() and symbol() == wstETH.

assertions.note: Secondary, on-chain checks applied on every run of scripts/protocol-reads.mjs. Any mismatch aborts before a fixture is written.
checks: symbol() equals the labelled symbol for WETH, eETH, weETH, stETH, wstETH — catches a wrong-but-callable address that a bytecode-only check would miss
WETH, weETH and wstETH are members of Pool.getReservesList() at the pinned block
LP.eETH() == weETH.eETH() (two independent paths to the same eETH)
